app.name: SnailNet
link.not_running.title: SnailNet isn't running
link.not_running.body: Your internet works normally, but nothing is being shared out. SnailNet connects by itself as soon as its service starts.
start.asked: Starting SnailNet… it connects in a moment.
start.cancelled: SnailNet wasn't started. Windows needs your permission to start it.
start.not_installed: The SnailNet service isn't installed on this PC. Reinstall SnailNet to get it back.
offline.title: No internet connection
offline.body: This PC isn't connected to a network. SnailNet keeps your split and picks up as soon as you're back online.
link.rejected.title: This copy of SnailNet can't control the service
link.rejected.body: Only the SnailNet app installed in the same folder as the service may change it. Open SnailNet from the Start menu instead.
link.denied.title: Windows didn't let SnailNet reach its service
link.denied.body: Signing out and back in usually fixes this. Details: {detail}
link.lost.title: Lost contact with SnailNet
link.lost.body: Reconnecting… Your internet keeps working meanwhile.
state.unshaped.title: Watching only
state.unshaped.body: Tell SnailNet how fast your connection is, and it starts sharing it out by your rules.
state.retrying.title: Traffic control stepped aside
state.retrying.body: Your internet works normally. SnailNet tries again in a moment. ({reason})
state.safe_mode.title: Safe mode
state.safe_mode.body: Traffic control stopped after {failures} problems in a row, so your internet runs as if SnailNet weren't here. Restart the SnailNet service to try again.
network.new.title: New network: {network}
network.new.body: SnailNet doesn't know this connection's speed yet, so it's only watching. Set or measure it once, and your split works here too.
line.title: Connection speed
line.body: Type the speeds a speed test shows for this connection. SnailNet shares it out at these speeds.
line.empty: Leave a box empty and SnailNet won't share out that direction.
line.invalid: Type a number from 0.1 to 10000, or leave it empty.
line.conflict: The settings changed somewhere else just now. This shows the new speeds; try again.
firstrun.label: Welcome
firstrun.welcome.title: Welcome to SnailNet
firstrun.welcome.body: Split your internet between apps, like 40% for downloads and 60% for YouTube.
firstrun.welcome.privacy: SnailNet only reads website names, never content, and nothing leaves your PC.
firstrun.speed.title: How fast is your connection?
firstrun.speed.body: SnailNet can measure it in about 20 seconds with Cloudflare's speed test, or you can type it. You can change it any time.
firstrun.done.title: You're set
firstrun.done.body: SnailNet is sharing out your connection. Pick a mode for what you're doing, or boost one app when it matters. A share nobody is using goes to whoever needs it.
firstrun.later.title: Watching only, for now
firstrun.later.body: Your internet works as before. When you know your speed, choose Set speed at the top of the window.
split.label: How your connection is shared
list.empty.title: No traffic yet
list.empty.body: Apps show up here as soon as they use the internet.
list.unknown: Traffic SnailNet couldn't tie to an app
editor.conflict: The rules changed somewhere else just now. This shows the new version; try again.
picker.title: Add a slice
picker.hint: Everything here already has a slice. Apps show up once they've used the internet.
status.held: using its whole slice, wants more
status.free: only when the line is free
status.off: off, so it's in Everything else
glance.quiet.title: Nothing is using your internet right now.
glance.quiet.body: Apps show up here as soon as they do.
glance.top.calm: {name} is using the most right now.
glance.top.busy: {name} is using the most of your line.
glance.room: {used} of {line} Mbps in use. There's room for everyone.
glance.borrow.from: It runs on room {lender} isn't using.
glance.held: SnailNet holds it to its slice.
glance.fine.one: {names} still gets all it asks for.
glance.fine.many: {names} still get all they ask for.
glance.alone: Nothing else needs the line right now.
strip.free: {mbps} Mbps kept free for low ping
dir.label: Show speeds for
edit.priority.hint: High goes first, which keeps games and calls quick. It never makes the slice bigger.
edit.free: Only when the line is free
edit.site: Works in every browser and comes before the browser's own slice.
list.add.long: Add a slice for an app or website
nav.label: Pages
sidebar.line.label: Your line: {down} Mbps download, {up} Mbps upload. Change it
now.title: What matters right now?
mode.label: Mode
mode.streaming.body: Video and calls first, downloads in the spare room.
mode.gaming.body: Voice chat first. Video and downloads step back for your game.
mode.quiet.body: Downloads only use what nobody else wants.
who.title: Using your internet
unnamed.body: from websites that hide their names, in {apps}. It still counts toward those apps' slices.
who.empty: Nothing is using your internet right now. Apps show up here as soon as they do.
boost.label: Boost {name}
boost.stop.label: Stop boosting {name}
boost.menu.title: Let {name} go first
boost.menu.body: It gets at least half your line, then everything goes back by itself.
coach.title: Give an app more with − and +
coach.body: Fine-tune opens every slice. Share nobody is using goes to whoever needs it, so none is wasted.
card.free.one: 1 more only when the line is free
card.free.many: {count} more only when the line is free
split.title: {mode} split
split.reset.done: The {mode} split is back to how it started.
settings.title: Settings
settings.networks.body: Each keeps its own speed. SnailNet switches when you join one.
measure.done: Measured {down} Mbps down and {up} Mbps up. SnailNet now shares that out.
measure.none: The speed test didn't finish. Check that you're online, or type your speed with Change.
ping.title: Ping while downloading
ping.body: {idle} ms when the line is quiet · {loaded} ms during a download without SnailNet
adapt.title: Follow the line automatically
adapt.body: SnailNet watches your ping and follows your line when it gets faster or slower. Turn off to keep the speed exactly as set.
focus.title: Put what you're using first
focus.body: The app in front gets its traffic out first, and a game keeps that for as long as it runs. It never takes a bigger share of your connection.
state.measuring.title: Measuring your connection
state.measuring.body: Sharing is off for about 20 seconds so the test can use the whole line.
settings.autostart.body: SnailNet waits in the tray, out of the way.
settings.resetMode.body: Puts {mode} back to how it started. Your other modes stay as they are.
settings.resetAll.body: Forgets every mode's split, your line speed and any boost, then shows setup again.
settings.resetAll.title: Reset SnailNet?
settings.resetAll.confirm: Every mode goes back to how it started and your line speed is cleared, so SnailNet only watches until you set it again. This can't be undone.
state.paused.title: SnailNet is paused
state.paused.body: Nothing is shared out or blocked, so your internet runs as if SnailNet weren't here. Back on: {left}.
pause.label: Pause SnailNet
pause.menu.body: Nothing is shared out or blocked while it's paused.
block.title: Blocked
block.unblock.label: Let {name} use the internet again
fold.title: {count} apps only when the line is free
fold.title.one: 1 app only when the line is free
